dedupe_keys.name: measured part deviations and simulated five axis cutting conditions

description: Uhlich, Dittrich and Denkena publish this dataset on Mendeley Data for self-optimising tool-path generation in five-axis machining. The description pairs measured shape deviations with process-parallel simulated cutting conditions, including width and depth of cut, projected tool distance, material-removal rate, feed rate and workpiece coordinates. CSV descriptors are listed. Coverage comprises Pocket A and Pocket B specimens with and without compensation, using systematic or random surface-point selection; the source distinguishes 9 uncompensated Pocket A parts and 3 parts in each other described group. The data supports calibration and comparison of manufacturing process models and tool-path optimisation. CC BY 4.0 terms are stated; reuse charges and acquisition dates are not stated. A limitation is that the source labels DepthOfCut as width of cut in its field description; that metadata conflict is preserved without guessing its corrected definition. Related experimental setup is deferred to a paper, whose body was not fetched. No point measurements, code or model files were obtained.
